_comment: One of four emitter shards run by .github/workflows/mutation-emitter.yml on Blacksmith. The emitter files are outside stryker-config.json's mutate scope, and all of them in one run (4,365 testable mutants) did not finish in 2 hours locally on 2026-10-02, so they are split by file into four shards. The split balances each file's testable mutants plus its timeouts (a timed-out mutant costs about 40 times a killed one) as measured by the first Blacksmith run, 36979486901 on 2026-10-02, where the old split took 32, 22, 6 and 8 minutes. Files are listed by name, not by glob range, so EmitterMutationShardTests can check every emitter file is in exactly one shard.
